changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla human_gradings: calificación manual de respuestas cortas (muestra aleatoria o a solicitud) para el QWK. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría human_gradings_audit y el trigger human_gradings_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Manual grading of short answers on a sample (quadratic weighted kappa)

column.name: attempt_answer_id
column.remarks: Answer that was graded by hand

column.name: grader_user_id
column.remarks: Instructor or assigned evaluator that graded

column.name: sample_type
column.remarks: Why the answer was graded: random or learner_request

column.name: score
column.remarks: Total score given by the human grader

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE human_gradings ADD CONSTRAINT human_gradings_sample_type_ck CHECK (sample_type IN ('random', 'learner_request'))
CREATE TRIGGER human_gradings_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON human_gradings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in human_gradings

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE human_gradings_audit ADD CONSTRAINT human_gradings_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER human_gradings_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON human_gradings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS human_gradings_audit_trg ON human_gradings
